text: Really good

Let me start by saying that this place has many rooms.
They have small, medium, and large sizes.
Each size has a different price. They also have board games, PlayStations, and lots of entertainment toys.
We booked a medium-sized room for 250 baht.
When we arrived and tried to open the door, someone was using our room (the staff informed us that someone had mistakenly entered our room and asked if we would like to use the smaller room first). So we used the small room next door instead.
We didn't mind, thinking that since there were only two of us, a small room wouldn't be a problem. After using the room for the full hour,
we went down to pay, but they charged us the price of the large room, not the small room. We felt like we were paying for something we didn't receive (we don't know if the person who mistakenly entered our room paid the price of the medium or small room). The staff said that the owner told them to charge the price we initially agreed upon, and that they would give us a discount next time... That's totally not okay. Not because of the 50 baht difference, but because if there were 10 people, you'd get 500 baht. If you think 50 baht is too little,

Consider this: You could rent a large pool villa for 6000 baht that can accommodate many people, but you're only two people and you can afford it. You just want the space, but then someone else is staying in your villa. The staff initially offered me a smaller room for 4000 baht, but upon check-out, I had to pay 6000 baht. Do you think that's fair?

If anyone goes to this place...
I have a discount code that the staff offered. 🫠
